description: NLP-based classification of emotion for the content. Serves an object of at most three emotions with associated confidence or affinity. Each emotion is one of a set of standard emotions.
prompt: NLP-based classification of emotion for the content. Serves an object of at most three emotions with associated confidence or affinity. Each emotion is one of a set of standard emotions.
notes: The schema defines a closed set of standard emotions (Plutchik and Ekman models) as keys with non-negative numeric confidence scores. It restricts the object to a maximum of three properties to meet the constraint without overly restricting the numeric scale of the confidence values.
